name: mirage
text: I checked the engine's own numbers rather than loosening blind. Live: it judged 387k lines and offered 0. 265k were skipped because Pinnacle has closed that line in play, 55k because its price isn't settled, 54k because the ask isn't an old Pinnacle price. Those are missing fair prices, not strict rules, so loosening a threshold wouldn't create bets. The 6 live bids are up. Pregame bets: of 13 looked at, 9 start over 48h out and 4 are totals or spreads that I removed last night. The data was totals -6%, spreads -3%, while moneylines, props and team totals won. Pregame bids: the engine halted its desk for picking off, because 4 of the last 8 fills had the fair move against them (+0.5% EV at fill versus +2.9% when posted). That safeguard is protecting money, so I'm not removing it. I can lift it earlier or raise the 48h limit if you want, but the evidence says that costs money. Tell me which and I'll do it. v1.0.113 (bets.json lag, OddsPapi cache removed) is building.
